title: Independent Living Trial Stay Credit on an Entrance Fee Agreement Cancellation Fee
content:
A Larkspur Independent Living Trial Stay is credited against the gross processing fee of a cancellation of an **Entrance Fee Agreement** before occupancy: the trial-stay credit share is set by the trial-stay nights charged in the 12 months before the cancellation, 7 or more nights taking a share of 1.0, 3 to 6 nights a share of 0.5, and fewer than 3 nights a share of 0; the credit is that share of the trial-stay nightly charges posted in the same 12 months, rounded to the cent half up, and it is subtracted from the gross processing fee, the result never falling below 0.00.

The gross processing fee is the processing fee figured on the entrance fee of the agreement.

## Records read

The trial-stay nights and nightly charges are those on the customer's **Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement** ledger: nightly charge entries billed as the Independent Living Trial Stay and posted in the 12 months before the cancellation. Nightly charges of other stay types do not count.

## Share ladder

| Trial-stay nights charged in the 12 months | Credit share |
|---|---|
| 7 or more | 1.0 |
| 3 to 6 | 0.5 |
| Fewer than 3 | 0 |

## Boundaries

| Nights | Share |
|---|---|
| 7 | 1.0 |
| 6 | 0.5 |
| 3 | 0.5 |
| 2 | 0 |

## Hypothetical illustrations

| Gross processing fee | Trial nights | Trial nightly charges | Share | Credit | Fee after the credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6818.00 | 5 | 1250.00 | 0.5 | 625.00 | 6193.00 |
| 6818.00 | 8 | 2000.00 | 1.0 | 2000.00 | 4818.00 |
| 1500.00 | 9 | 2400.00 | 1.0 | 2400.00 | 0.00 |
| 6818.00 | 2 | 500.00 | 0 | 0.00 | 6818.00 |
